messages:
Nina: Heads-up 10: Lumina channel partner submitted a reconciliation — their onboarding promo was applied to partner-managed merchants through Feb and created an $8,760 liability. They want a single partner-level rebate or individual merchant refunds.
Ethan: Can you paste the sample rows?
Nina: They included this snippet: `invoice_id,merchant,period,charged,should_have,delta
inv-1457,Goodwell,2025-02,$1,200,$800,$400
inv-1462,StellarCo,2025-02,$1,000,$600,$400`
Jo: Looks like a promo-tier flag didn't flip during absorb. Is total $8,760 across 14 merchants?
Nina: Correct, 14 merchants after proration.
Miguel: Ops question: do we issue a consolidated credit memo to Lumina or wire reimbursements to each merchant? Partner agreement says partner-level credits allowed. Consolidated is lower ops overhead.
Tara: Finance lead here 10: approve consolidated partner rebate to Lumina for $8,760. Use GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025`. Memo: "Lumina onboarding promo corrective rebate Jan\nFeb 2025". Need Lumina signed allocation ack and a partner reference for our ledger.
finance-bot: Created FIN-5018. Status: awaiting Lumina ack and sample CSV. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-5018
Ethan: One control question 10: since amount > $5k, did we notify the CFO?
Tara: FYI sent to CFO; she replied via DM that finance lead approval ok but please add a one-liner to month-end close.
Miguel: For posting, Lumina prefers a credit memo (per their note). They provided partner ref `LUM-ONB-2025`.
Jo: Please confirm tax treatment with AP/TAX before posting; partner rebates can have VAT implications when partners pass credits to merchants.
Nina: Pinged Tax; they asked for the CSV and the signed ack before advising.
finance-bot: FIN-5018 updated: attachments required = sample CSV, Lumina ack PDF, tax confirmation, approval thread link.
Miguel: I'll draft the credit memo and include Lumina's ref. ETA post once ack in. Scheduling posting 2025-03-30 EOD to match accruals.
Ethan: After posting, update the Q1 reconciliation workbook and tag the line as "Partner rebate 1 corrective" so it shows up in the PL commentary.
Tara: Noted. Also request Product add a preflight check to the onboarding flow to reject promo flags that would create negative or corrective liabilities. Filed P-1329.
Nina: Lumina sent the signed ack PDF just now. Attaching to FIN-5018.
finance-bot: FIN-5018 updated: ack attached. Status: ready for posting.
Miguel: Posting credit memo now. Will confirm with a final message when posted.
Miguel: Credit memo posted: REF CM-2025-1843, posted 2025-03-30, amount $8,760. :white_check_mark:
Tara: Thanks. Please close FIN-5018 and add month-end note: "Partner rebate to Lumina for onboarding promo correction, $8,760."
finance-bot: FIN-5018 closed by Miguel.
